statements.status_notes: The SSH credential exposure through hashicorp/go-getter in Fleet (fixed in Rancher 2.5.13 and 2.6.4) needs go-getter, which neither binary contains: go version -m lists only github.com/rancher/fleet/pkg/apis from Fleet and no go-getter module. The binaries link github.com/rancher/rancher at the 2026 commits af09b55e6d28 and 8c257d748d23, which the scanner matches only because their 0.0.0 pseudo-versions sort below the fixed release tags.

The retained privileges after project removal (GHSA-28g7-896h-695v) were fixed in Rancher v2.4.18, v2.5.12 and v2.6.3; both pinned commits descend from v2.6.3 and from the fix commit 3c1d5fac32482f00828bec2a4eda39a431a4dbe4. The binaries link github.com/rancher/rancher at the 2026 commits af09b55e6d28 and 8c257d748d23, which the scanner matches only because their 0.0.0 pseudo-versions sort below the fixed release tags.

The cross-site scripting through malicious links (GHSA-6m8r-jh89-rq7h) affects the Rancher server web interface before 2.5.6. kube-api-auth serves only the JSON endpoints /healthcheck and /v1/authenticate, and go tool nm on the 0.13 and 0.15 -dev binaries lists only API types, pkg/auth/settings, pkg/auth/tokens/hashers, pkg/catalogv2, pkg/wrangler, pkg/tunnelserver authorizers and generated controllers from github.com/rancher/rancher. The binaries link github.com/rancher/rancher at the 2026 commits af09b55e6d28 and 8c257d748d23, which the scanner matches only because their 0.0.0 pseudo-versions sort below the fixed release tags.

The cross-site websocket hijacking (GHSA-xhg2-rvm8-w2jh) was fixed in Rancher v2.2.5 by commit 0ddffe484adc in pkg/clusterrouter, pkg/websocket and server/server.go. go tool nm on the 0.13 and 0.15 -dev binaries lists only API types, pkg/auth/settings, pkg/auth/tokens/hashers, pkg/catalogv2, pkg/wrangler, pkg/tunnelserver authorizers and generated controllers from github.com/rancher/rancher, none of those, and kube-api-auth serves no websocket. The binaries link github.com/rancher/rancher at the 2026 commits af09b55e6d28 and 8c257d748d23, which the scanner matches only because their 0.0.0 pseudo-versions sort below the fixed release tags.

The privilege escalation (GHSA-gc62-j469-9gjm) was fixed in Rancher v2.2.4; both pinned commits carry every commit of Rancher v2.3.0 except its 7 release-only commits, and go tool nm on the 0.13 and 0.15 -dev binaries lists only API types, pkg/auth/settings, pkg/auth/tokens/hashers, pkg/catalogv2, pkg/wrangler, pkg/tunnelserver authorizers and generated controllers from github.com/rancher/rancher, none of the management controllers. The binaries link github.com/rancher/rancher at the 2026 commits af09b55e6d28 and 8c257d748d23, which the scanner matches only because their 0.0.0 pseudo-versions sort below the fixed release tags.

The binaries link github.com/rancher/rancher at the 2026 commits af09b55e6d28 and 8c257d748d23, which the scanner matches only because their 0.0.0 pseudo-versions sort below the fixed release tags.
